title: Launch velocity — First 100k users readiness map & KPI bridge
content:
Overview:

This doc maps the tactical readiness and KPI signal path for a customer-facing launch intended to scale to the first 100k users (approx. 12–16 weeks post-initial-beta depending on acquisition velocity). Purpose is to create a single source of truth for product-ops, product, eng, SRE, and growth teams so we can: 
- track milestone ownership and blockers in one place,
- define concrete success metrics across early, mid, and stable phases, and
- lock down the day-of and post-launch playbook for latency/cost/stability incidents and adoption follow-up.

Scope & assumptions:
- Target cohort: public rollout (freemium + paid conversion) for hosted API + web demo surface.
- Traffic profile assumption: median request size ~ 300 tokens, peak QPS up to 700 during marketing spikes, baseline 50 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: first-100k should be demonstrably within our projected unit-cost baseline (see KPIs).
- Rollout model: phased traffic ramp (canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%) tied to KPI gates below.

Objectives (what success looks like):
- Onboarding: 60% of signups complete first prompt within 7 days.
- Retention: 30% 7-day retention, 18% 30-day retention on the freemium tier.
- Latency: p50 < 180ms, p95 < 700ms for gated model calls; no p99 > 2s sustained for > 15 minutes.
- Cost: per-token inference cost not to exceed projected baseline by >20% during first-90 days.
- Incident rate: < 1 major production incident / month attributable to rollout config in the first 90 days.

KPI & signal bridge (phases and thresholds):
Phase A: Day 0–7 (canary, narrow audience)
- Activation rate (signup -> first prompt): target >= 55%
- Error rate (5xx per minute): target < 0.5%
- Latency p95: target < 700ms
- Conversion trial opt-ins (if applicable): baseline TBD by growth
Gates: if error rate > 1% for 10m or p95 > 1.2s for 15m -> rollback to canary or reduce concurrency.

Phase B: Week 2–4 (ramped exposure)
- DAU growth linearity: smooth ramp vs marketing -> observed uplift should not create >2x baseline QPS jump within 30m window
- Cost per DAU: track live; alert if unit cost > +15% vs baseline for 24h
- Quality regressions: automated eval set must not show >3% BLEU/semantic quality drop vs control
Gates: pause traffic ramp if retention or quality signals fall by >20% vs canary cohort for 48h.

Phase C: Week 5–90 (scale & stabilize)
- 7d/30d retention targets met (see Objectives)
- NPS / in-app satisfaction > 35 (qualitative signals for product fit)
- Cost delta vs baseline <= +10% (optimization playbook engaged if exceeded)

Launch readiness checklist (pre-launch, day-of, post-launch windows):
Pre-launch (must be green before canary):
- [ ] Model pin / rollback tags in release config (owner: Devon)
- [ ] Canary cluster provisioned + smoke tests passing (owner: SRE - Liam)
- [ ] Autoscale policy validated with synthetic spikes to 3x expected peak (owner: infra - Zara)
- [ ] Observability: dashboards (latency, errors, token-cost), traces, and alert thresholds deployed (owner: Observability - Marina)
- [ ] Billing & quota guardrails configured to prevent runaway cost (owner: Finance - Ethan)
- [ ] Growth comms plan and throttle script ready (owner: Growth)
- [ ] Rollout plan documented with traffic percentages and gates (this doc)

Day-of (canary -> 10%):
- Canary launch at T0 + 10m: monitor first 60m for anomalies
- Live checklist during first 2h: churn in p95/p99, 5xx spikes, backend queue growth
- Contact rota: SRE on-call, infra lead, product-ops owner, growth lead, engineering lead (contact list maintained in SOC runbook)
- Communication template ready for status updates to stakeholders and customers

Post-launch (first 24h & 72h critical window):
- 0–4h: escalate any sustained p95 regressions; immediate rollback if sustained errors > 2% for 30m
- 4–24h: manual review of telemetry and QA sampling of outputs for hallucinations or quality drift
- 24–72h: run automated A/B evaluation to verify sample quality; finalize go/no-go for full ramp
- 7 days: cross-functional review of activation & retention — decide next ramp cadence

Rollout control & triggers (operational playbook):
- Throttle down: automated policy decreases allowed concurrency by 30% when token cost rate > threshold AND error rate rising; manual override by SRE lead required to resume.
- Rollback: immediate rollback to previous model/version if false-positive rate or hallucination rate crosses set threshold on post-launch eval set (owner: Applied ML).
- Fail-open vs fail-closed: default is fail-open for non-security critical surfaces with clear user messaging; fail-closed for regulated customers (dedicated/private deployments).

Roadmap tracker (milestones, owners, due dates, signals):
- Week -4: End-to-end runbook reviewed & dry-run (owner: Priya) — status: complete
- Week -3: Canary infra smoke test + autoscale validation (owner: Liam) — status: complete
- Week -2: Growth funnel playbook and comms assets ready (owner: Ethan) — status: in_review
- Week -1: QA sampling & eval set freeze (owner: Marina) — status: done
- Day 0: Canary -> 10% (owner: product-ops) — status: scheduled
- Day 3: A/B quality evaluation & decision point (owner: applied-ml) — status: scheduled
- Week 2: 30% ramp (owner: product) — gate: pass A/B quality + retention signal
- Week 6: Full ramp (owner: product) — gate: stability, retention, cost in-range

Escalation playbook (quick reference):
- Severity P1 (user-facing outage or cascading errors): page SRE on-call -> product-ops lead -> eng lead -> exec on-call. Run SOC incident template.
- Severity P2 (quality degradation, cost spike): alert product-ops & applied-ml, run targeted rollback if needed.
- Communication cadence: immediate banner (if outage) + 1h status updates until stable + postmortem within 72h.

Open questions & TODOs (notes to self / working items):
- Define exact conversion KPI for paid tier within Phase B (action: Growth to propose numbers by 2025-01-20).
- Confirm analytics event names to avoid mismatched instrumentation (action: Analytics team to freeze event list).
- Prepare a small evaluation prompt set that reflects edge-case enterprise queries (action: Applied ML).
- Run a simulated cost-storm (4x baseline tokens for 2h) to validate billing guardrails (owner: Finance + Infra).

Appendix — quick metrics dashboard snapshot (fields to include in the live sheet):
- rolling-1h-requests, rolling-1h-errors, p50/p95/p99 latency, avg tokens per call, token-cost-per-minute, retention-7d, retention-30d, activation-rate, signup->first-prompt time, conversion-rate-trial->paid

Notes on collaboration & links:
- Use the Confluence plan (linked above) for long-form rationale and historical decisions.
- Track blockers as Jira tickets and add the ticket key in the rollout tracker row.
- Keep this doc alive during the first 90 days; product-ops will update status after each checkpoint.

Author notes (informal):
- This is intentionally pragmatic — fewer friction points during ramp are more valuable than theoretical perfection. Expect a handful of quick follow-ups after the canary.
- If anything feels ambiguous in the gates above, flag in the growth/product standup and we’ll tighten the numeric thresholds.

-- Priya (product-ops)
